text.name: settings_lbl
text.tool_tip: Automatically adjust settings to maintain FPS. Set the Target to the desired frame rate and the viewer will attempt to match this by dynamically altering your settings.

spinner.name: target_fps
spinner.tool_tip: Target FPS - The desired FPS level. The viewer will attempt to achieve this by adjusting your graphics settings.

button.name: AutoTuneFPS
button.label: Başla
button.tool_tip: The viewer will attempt to adjust settings to meet the target FPS.

check_box.name: AutoTuneContinuous
check_box.label: Continuous
check_box.tool_tip: The viewer will continually adapt the settings to meet the target FPS until stopped even with the floater closed. When disabled clicking the Auto Tune button will adjust for the current settings then stop.

button.name: PrefSaveButton
button.tool_tip: Save the current settings to a default for future use.

button.name: Defaults
button.tool_tip: Reload default graphics settings for your hardware.
